answer: A behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes because its deposit unlocks only as real work habits accumulate. Each identity locks 200 credits, released in four 50-credit stages as its timing and task order match its onyx record. The kth fake needs a fresh history to climb each terrace, so marginal cost stays 240 credits and never falls with volume. Thus 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 credits plus 40,000 for rented histories, while reused patterns, called timber laundering, freeze the escrow. One honest agent pays 200 once and recovers it in full.
